svg.text: The question here is simple: which slow radial bands are truly stubborn, and which ones were only budget-limited at the earlier cutoff?
converged fraction by start radius at 40 iterations
converged fraction by start radius at 80 iterations
recovered share when the budget rises from 40 to 80

text.tspan: If the bottom panel stays high, the earlier cutoff was hiding recoverable points.
If it falls close to zero, the remaining difficulty is geometry, not just the 40-step budget.
